items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1957-04-16
items.q: Because I didn't meet Oren now. You see, Oren was in Oakland... I told him I'd come back.

ctx.x: Because I didn't meet Oren now. You see, Oren was in Oakland. He's butt. See? And they was waiting on 11 in, uh, Broadway, a little cafe there. Five of them. I told him I'd come back. He said, Well, uh, why? I said, Well, I think I'll have to stay out here. I ain't going no further. I got you a corner woman now. You don't want to go no further, huh? You don't have to be a native.
Because you got your corner and you got you a good woman now.
